analysis.title: GS Sharkey - US Equities Mid Day Color 1 Oct 2026
key_insights: US equities rose midday on 10/1 with NDX +50bps, RTY +34bps and SPX +27bps as yields cooled and WTI backed off its highs.
September's SPX market-cap vs equal-weight performance gap was a top-5 move over the last 30+ years. A reversion is under way today, with SPW +47bps vs SPX +27bps.
ACN rose 18%, its highest 1-day gain on record, on better numbers across the board against very bearish expectations and a short setup. Global IT Services (GSXGITSV) rose 6% on the print.
Credit spreads dominated financials inbounds. Spreads are still at historical tights and, adjusted for roll, are now at the July wides. Some equity investors are looking at non-roll-adjusted figures.
High expected issuance, despite higher rates, combined with weak performance of recent large deals is creating indigestion in credit.
High yield has seen divergence between higher and lower quality credit, with focus on levered credits exposed to the consumer.
The GS cross asset desk sees growing interest in using credit as a macro hedging vehicle.

GS Global Investment Research added AMZN to its conviction list with a PT of $375, citing AWS strength where AI workloads drive topline momentum and operating margins. AMZN is +8% YTD and trails only MSFT among megacaps this year.
ETF share of the tape rose to 32% over the last few sessions. CTA thresholds on SPX are ST 7661, MT 7448, LT 6980.
GS floor flow is 3% better to buy with activity at 4 out of 10. Long-only clients are balanced with a slight seller skew on small notional, and hedge funds are better buyers.
Chart of the Day: fixed income ETF trading volumes accelerated rapidly as the 10-year yield pushed through 5% this month.

market_movers.rationale: Shares rose 18%, the largest 1-day gain on record, after results beat very bearish expectations across the board against a short setup.
Added to the GIR conviction list with the PT raised to $375 on AWS strength. AI workloads are driving topline momentum and operating margins, and Physical AI should support further margin expansion.

earnings_insights: ACN reported better numbers across the board vs very bearish expectations, and the stock rose 18% on 10/1 (figures not given in the note).
AMZN: AWS strength is the basis for the PT raise to $375, with AI workloads supporting topline growth and operating margins.

macro_indicators.interpretation: Fixed income ETF trading volumes accelerated rapidly as the 10-year moved through 5%.

risk_factors: Credit indigestion from high issuance expectations and weak performance of recent large deals.
Divergence within high yield, with levered consumer-exposed credits weaker.
charts_described: Chart of the Day shows fixed income ETF trading volumes accelerating rapidly as the 10yr yield pushed through 5% this month.
vol_and_positioning: CTA thresholds on SPX: short-term 7661, medium-term 7448, long-term 6980.
ETF share of the tape is 32%, up over the last few sessions.
Hedge funds are better buyers, with demand most pronounced in macro products, info tech, financials and consumer discretionary, and supply in materials and healthcare.

Long-only clients are mostly balanced with a slight seller skew on small notional. They are selling financials, communication services, materials and industrials, and buying info tech, healthcare and macro products.
ACN had a short setup into the print.
